Subject: MAP: run-level performance gating & close timeline — week 32 checkpoint

Hi Samantha / Alan —

Quick weekly checkpoint on the MAP and the evaluation plan before we lock the close timeline later this quarter. Summary below; full notes and raw results attached.

TL;DR:
- We validated the core inference path at target QPS but saw 8-12% tail-latency regressions at 99th pct on long-context scenarios.
- Immediate action: enable KV prefix caching for the 8am-10am peak window and re-run the throughput sweep on Thursday (08/20).
- Proposed close milestone: preliminary production roll (canary) week of 2026-09-07 if Thursday results look good.

Bench results (attached: perf_results_0818.csv):
- Baseline (no caching): 250 QPS sustain, p50=45ms, p95=210ms, p99=560ms on 2xA100 (batching tuned).
- With continuous batching + short-kv: p50=38ms, p95=160ms, p99=495ms.
- With KV prefix caching (internal test): p50=35ms, p95=128ms, p99=320ms (best-case).

Meeting notes / asks:
1) Karthik: prioritize a KV cache toggle that can be enabled by policy and logs cache hit rate to tracing. Target: EOD Wed (08/19) for a dev patch.
2) Neha: update the MAP timeline spreadsheet to reflect the new gating criteria (p99 < 400ms on long-context at target QPS).
3) Marissa: confirm procurement cadence so we can schedule canary infra for 09/07 and lock the committed capacity.

Proposed next steps and owners (short):
- Karthik Iyer (owner): KV toggle + instrumented metrics — due 2026-08-19 17:00 PT.
- Neha Kapoor (owner): MAP_v3_timeline.xlsx updated & circulate — due 2026-08-19 12:00 PT.
- Marissa Cole (owner): Procurement ask & contract alignment for dedicated capacity (PO timeline) — due 2026-08-20.
- StellarHealth (Samantha / Alan): share any scheduled load tests and preferred blackout windows for the Thursday sweep.

Attached: perf_results_0818.csv (summary + raw traces), latency_trace_0818.txt (sample p99 traces), MAP_v3_timeline.xlsx (proposed gating).

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.

—Rachel
